newsitem.title: USA: Delaware teachers say unhappy with pay hike plan.
newsitem.headline: Delaware teachers say unhappy with pay hike plan.

text.p: Members of the Delaware State Education Association said they are not happy with the state's latest offer of a three percent pay raise for teachers.
Gov. Tom Carper originally put a two percent pay hike in his proposed budget, but the legislature's joint finance committee upped it to three percent.
DSEA President Mary Ann Pry called the new offer "insulting."
Pry said the education association, which has 8,500 members, is pushing for a five percent raise, arguing that Delaware teacher salaries are below those of New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
The group said if the trend continues, it will become more and more difficult to attract teachers to the state.
